coaching.headline: Ten structures to two and all three Fangtooths, but seven straight enemy kills after the Orb Prime shrank a stomp to a one-kill fucking lead.
coaching.team: Bayle drew first blood on Iggy & Scorch, the team drew level at one apiece and never trailed again, finishing twenty-seven to twenty-one on kills. The team took all three Fangtooths, both Mini Primes, the Orb Prime, two of three Genesis Cores and ten structures while losing two outer towers; the enemy took both Primal Fangtooths. After the Orb Prime the enemy scored seven straight kills and took the second Primal Fangtooth and a Genesis Core before five unanswered allied kills, two inhibitors and the Core ended the game.

focus.title: Spend the Orb Prime on structures
focus.action: Once the Orb Prime is taken with an enemy inhibitor already down, call the next structure and walk in together behind an allied minion wave. No side fights until that structure falls; seven straight deaths with the enemy base open is a gift.

17.2.call: Gadget killed Iggy & Scorch, Kira killed Eden and Adele, and Greystone killed Bayle. The fight went 3-1, an enemy inner tower fell shortly after and the Mini Prime went to the team soon after that. Win the fight, then cash the structure.

27.7.call: Iggy & Scorch died outside any detected fight and the enemy took the second Primal Fangtooth shortly after. In the next fight Eden killed Greystone and Gadget killed Phase and Kira, with no enemy deaths. The fight went 0-3, and the enemy added a Genesis Core later in the same run.

31.8.call: Iggy & Scorch killed Eden, Greystone killed Adele and Kira killed Crunch with no allied deaths. The fight went 3-0, two enemy inhibitors fell in the same window and the enemy Core went down right after. Five unanswered kills across the last two fights ended the enemy run.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran Kira like a proper fucking carry: the second-most kills, hero damage and objective damage in the game, hero damage per minute well above the recorded Kira norm, and Eden and Adele dead to Kira five times.

Eden killed Kira three times, more than any enemy managed on any single ally. When Eden swaps into the claws with Zero Shift, Kira saves Shadow Glide for the exit instead of spending the dash to start the trade.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 did the support job on Phase: the most healing and the most assists in the game, a hand in nearly half the team's kills, and ward placements right on the recorded Phase norm. Proper nurse shit.

Phase was the team's first death in two fights, and Adele got Phase twice. With Adele in range, Phase holds Phase Blink for the Imperial Lash root; landing Psychic Flare on a hero shortens that Blink cooldown.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a: notbutafish ran a heavy jungle game on Kwang: the most objective damage and damage mitigated in the game, deaths under the recorded Kwang norm, and all three Fangtooths, both Mini Primes and the Orb Prime to the team.
One ward placed is far under the recorded Kwang norm, with two wards cleared. If wards were equipped and sat unused, Kwang swaps to sentry next game and sweeps before each Primal Fangtooth.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64: Iggy & Scorch was the best player in this lobby: most kills, hero damage and gold in the game, hero damage per minute far above the recorded norm, and Bayle torched six times. A walking fucking bonfire.

Seven deaths led the team, two outside any detected fight, and the enemy took the second Primal Fangtooth soon after the later one. Security Gate roots whoever walks through, so Iggy & Scorch steps around the gate, never through.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070: candres507Pty-cd buried Crunch on Greystone: three kills on Crunch for one in return, the fewest deaths on the team, and hero damage per minute well above the recorded Greystone norm. Nothing soft about that shit.

Two deaths while soaking the second-most damage on the team is the standard now. When Crunch jumps a shooter, Greystone answers with Assault The Gates, since a hero hit cuts the leap cooldown for the next engage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 5 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

loadout.name: Fracture
